Hi Tom and Claire —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap of what we covered and proposed next steps: 

- Key goals: reduce inference latency for patient-facing summaries, centralize model serving, and establish strict data controls for PHI.
- Next internal steps for Orchard: stakeholder mapping (economic buyer, procurement, legal, security), and confirm the systems where Redwood will have inbound API access vs. batch/SFTP.
- Security ask: Tom mentioned you have an initial questionnaire — if you could send that over we can start intake and loop our security lead.

Proposed next steps:
1) Please confirm the economic buyer and legal/procurement contacts (we'll add them to the MAP).
2) Send your security questionnaire and any architecture diagrams you can share.
3) Marissa (cc'd) will follow up to schedule a security kickoff and clarify scope.

Attaching the post-demo deck with architecture callouts.

Thanks —

Subject: Security review kickoff & scope clarification

Hi Tom / Claire —

Thanks for the questionnaire and diagram — appreciate the quick turnaround. I’m Marissa, security lead for Redwood’s enterprise intake — I’ll be owning the review and intake process for Orchard.

A few clarifying questions so we scope the kickoff correctly: 
- Data in scope: you mentioned anonymized patient summaries in prod and de-identified test data in staging — can you confirm whether any PHI will ever transit our platform (names, MRNs, SSNs)?
- Integration pattern: is the primary flow REST API (OAuth 2.0) or will you be pushing files (SFTP/batch)? If both, please call out which systems use which flow.
- Environments in scope: prod only or prod + staging + sandbox?
- Retention / logging: expected retention window for logs and generated content, and whether you require customer-managed encryption keys (KMS/HSM) for logs/audit trails.
- Compliance artifacts: please send SOC 2 report / bridge letter if available and any relevant architecture diagrams.

Proposed kickoff agenda (attached):
- Introductions & roles
- Scope confirmation (data sets, environments, integrations)
- Timeline & deliverables (questionnaire intake, evidence collection, SOC2 review)
- Procurement/legal asks & mutual action plan

I’m available for a 30–45 minute kickoff today 4:00–5:30pm PT or tomorrow 9:00–11:00am PT. Priya / Neha — can you help confirm a time that works for Orchard?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0110

Marissa / Priya —

I recommend we propose a 2-week intake timeline: questionnaire completion by EOD Thu, evidence collection next week, kickoff readout and draft MAP by the end of next week.

Also suggest we explicitly request: SOC2 or bridge letter, encryption requirements (KMS), network allowlist IPs, and a copy of any DPAs they expect. I’ll draft the MAP template after the kickoff and share for review.
